name: What preparations do I need to make before a window sill replacement project begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before a window sill replacement project begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your exterior window sill replacement project, you should remove any window treatments, decorative items, or furniture near the windows to allow clear access for our crew. We also recommend clearing the exterior area directly below and around the windows, such as moving plants, outdoor furniture, or decorative items. This preparation ensures our team can work efficiently and safely without obstructions. Providing clear access inside and outside streamlines the process, helping us complete the work promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear window treatments, furniture, and exterior items around the windows to ensure clear access for the replacement crew.
